note: Rendering recipes for cartoon/illustration (line, colour, shading, texture, background). All untested in our pipeline. extends_style_ids point to .claude/skills/ai-visual-artist/ART_STYLE_LIBRARY.json; recipes add rendering detail, they do not duplicate those entries. FLUX prompts describe qualities, never artist or studio names. Numbers are starting points (craft/derived) unless a source key says otherwise.

recipes.name: TV anime cel, one shadow tone
recipes.line: Dark line, one weight family: silhouette 3-4 px, inner 1.5-2 px @1080; line colour = very dark warm brown, not #000.
recipes.shading: One hard-edged shadow shape per colour region (shadow = designed shape, not computed); light from one side; no gradients.
recipes.colour: Base fills + one shadow colour per base: shift hue 10-25 deg toward blue/violet, raise chroma slightly, drop OKLCH L by 0.12-0.18.
recipes.texture: None; perfectly flat fills.
recipes.background_approach: Painted or flat BG with lower contrast than the character; BG has no black outlines.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: base path fill; shadow = second path clipped (clip-path) to the base shape; outline group on top. Shadow colour from a CSS var per base (--skin, --skin-sh).
recipes.flux_prompt: clean anime cel shading, flat colours, single hard-edged shadow tone, crisp dark brown line art, no gradients, simple shapes
recipes.limits: Shadow shapes that cover eyes/mouth read as dirt - delete or redesign them (Todo2007). Weak on blobby forms if lines are the only cue (Cole2009).

recipes.name: Two-tone cel with hue-shifted shadows and designed highlights
recipes.line: As cel_1tone_tv; inner lines may be coloured (darker version of local fill).
recipes.shading: Shadow 1 (large) + shadow 2 (small, in creases/occlusion) + one designed highlight shape (bar on hair, dot/rectangle in eyes).
recipes.colour: Shadow 1: hue toward cool, L -0.12; shadow 2: hue further, L -0.25; highlight warm-white, never pure #fff on skin. Saturation rises near the terminator (warm red edge on skin).
recipes.texture: Optional: soften only the shadow edge 1-2 px.
recipes.background_approach: Painted BG (anime_painterly_bg) or soft gradient BG.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: three stacked clipped paths per region; terminator = 1 px saturated warm stroke along the shadow edge; highlights as separate paths on top, shape keyed per pose.
recipes.flux_prompt: anime illustration, two-tone cel shading with cool violet shadows, warm terminator edge, glossy hair highlight band, sparkling eye highlights, clean line art
recipes.limits: Second tone adds work per pose; at small sizes shadow 2 becomes noise - drop it below ~300 px character height.

recipes.name: Cool-to-warm illustration shading (lines + mid-tone fills)
recipes.line: Black edge lines on silhouette, creases and occlusions only.
recipes.shading: Smooth shading kept in mid-tones; orientation shown by hue (cool facing away, warm facing light), not darkness. No cast shadows.
recipes.colour: Blue undertone on shadow side, yellow undertone on lit side; local colour stays recognisable; white only for the specular highlight.
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: Plain light neutral or very simple ground so black lines and white highlights stay the extremes.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG linearGradient per shape from k_cool to k_warm (start: k_cool = blue 0.4 + 0.2*base, k_warm = yellow 0.4 + 0.6*base); 3D: Gooch formula in a shader.
recipes.flux_prompt: technical illustration style, cool blue to warm yellow shading, black outlines, white specular highlights, no cast shadows, clean background
recipes.limits: Hue shift distorts true colour - bad when product colour must be exact. Appeal untested with our audience.

recipes.name: Rim light instead of outline (commercial-illustration look)
recipes.line: No dark outline; silhouette defined by a bright rim on the side away from the key light, plus value contrast to BG.
recipes.shading: Painterly or 2-3 band shading with warm-to-cool shift; shadows cool, terminator saturated/reddened.
recipes.colour: Muted dominant palette with small saturated accents; rim colour = colour of the back light.
recipes.texture: Loose visible brush strokes in BG; characters cleaner.
recipes.background_approach: Dark or mid-value BG so the rim reads; low detail and low repetition.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: copy the silhouette, flood rim colour, subtract an offset copy (feOffset toward the key light + feComposite operator='out'), blur 0.5 px, place on top.
recipes.flux_prompt: stylised illustration, strong rim light outlining the figure, no black outlines, warm-to-cool shading, painterly muted background
recipes.limits: Needs a darker background; on white feeds the silhouette disappears.

recipes.name: Clear line (uniform line, flat colour)
recipes.line: One uniform line weight everywhere, characters and BG alike; no hatching, no taper.
recipes.shading: No modelling, or flat cast-shadow shapes only.
recipes.colour: Flat bright local colours; depth from overlap and colour.
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: Detailed, fully lined BG at the same weight; characters separated by stronger local colour, BG lighter/greyer.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: vector-effect='non-scaling-stroke', one stroke-width var for all paths; flat fills.
recipes.flux_prompt: clear-line comic illustration, uniform thin black outlines on everything, flat colours, no hatching, no gradients, detailed clean background, bright daylight
recipes.limits: Uniform weight loses depth cues (the deliberate exception in EDGE_CONTROL 2.4); busy BG can swallow the character unless colour separates them.

recipes.name: Brush inking with thick-thin taper and spotted blacks
recipes.line: Tapered brush lines: thicker on shadow side and under forms, thin on light side, tapered free ends; solid black masses for big shadows.
recipes.shading: Shading by black shapes (spotting blacks) and some feathering; no grey.
recipes.colour: B/W, or B/W over one flat colour layer.
recipes.texture: Dry-brush breaks at fast stroke ends.
recipes.background_approach: BG in thinner pen line or lighter ink so characters lead.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: draw strokes as filled variable-width outlines (pressure-style width); spotted blacks as filled paths; feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap scale 1-2 for slight wobble.
recipes.flux_prompt: black brush ink illustration, expressive thick-to-thin tapered lines, spotted solid black shadows, dry brush texture, white paper
recipes.limits: Width rules are craft; computational support from isophote-distance thickness (Hertzmann2010). Hard to keep consistent across frames.

recipes.name: Pen and ink with form-following hatching
recipes.line: Even technical-pen lines; contours plus hatching.
recipes.shading: Value from hatch density and cross-hatching; direction follows form (cross-contour) or one global direction as a style.
recipes.colour: Monochrome; optional single wash.
recipes.texture: The hatch lines are the texture.
recipes.background_approach: BG hatched in a different direction/density so characters separate by texture (EDGE_CONTROL 2.5).
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG pattern of parallel lines rotated per region (patternTransform), masked by a luminance mask from the shading; or XDoG hatching on a render.
recipes.flux_prompt: pen and ink illustration, fine cross-hatching following the form, technical pen lines, white paper, no colour
recipes.limits: Dense hatching moires on video and downscaled images - keep spacing >= 3 px at final size.

recipes.name: Coloured line art (colour holds)
recipes.line: Outer silhouette dark; inner lines recoloured to a darker version of the adjacent fill; shadow borders, if lined at all, in the shadow colour - never black.
recipes.shading: Any cel or soft shading.
recipes.colour: Line colour = fill hue, L -0.3 to -0.4, chroma slightly up.
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: BG lines (if any) close to BG hue so they recede.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: stroke=var(--region-line) per inner path; raster: lock line layer transparency and paint over it; or multiply a line layer over the fills.
recipes.flux_prompt: soft coloured line art, outlines tinted to match each colour area, gentle illustration, warm palette
recipes.limits: Inner lines that are too light lose form on small screens; keep the outer contour darkest.

recipes.name: Line-less flat shapes
recipes.line: No outlines; edges are colour/value boundaries.
recipes.shading: Flat or one shadow shape; overlap gives depth.
recipes.colour: Every adjacent pair of shapes must differ in value, not only hue; test in greyscale.
recipes.texture: Optional subtle grain.
recipes.background_approach: BG in a different value band from the character (light BG / dark character or the reverse).
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG fills only; a 0.5-1 px same-colour stroke hides anti-alias seams. Preview with CSS filter: grayscale(1).
recipes.flux_prompt: flat illustration without outlines, solid colour shapes, clear value contrast between shapes, minimal, modern
recipes.limits: Equiluminant neighbours vanish (greyscale, colour-vision deficiency); thin parts (glasses temples) need a value edge or they disappear.

recipes.name: Flat vector, geometric
recipes.line: None or thin uniform; geometric primitives; one corner radius for the whole set.
recipes.shading: Flat; optional one soft gradient or a long flat shadow at a fixed angle.
recipes.colour: 4-6 colours incl. one accent, defined as CSS tokens.
recipes.texture: None (or very fine noise against gradient banding).
recipes.background_approach: Flat colour fields / geometric shapes; no perspective, or isometric.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Pure SVG. Long shadow: polygon extruded at 45 deg with a linear-gradient to transparent. Corner radius as a token.
recipes.flux_prompt: flat vector illustration, geometric shapes, limited palette, clean, minimal, smooth, no texture
recipes.limits: Reads generic/corporate when overused; low warmth.

recipes.name: Limited palette 3+1 (works with any line style)
recipes.line: Any.
recipes.shading: Any; shadows mixed from the palette, no new hues.
recipes.colour: 3 main colours (light, mid, dark) of one temperature + 1 accent reserved for the story object; mother colour mixed 5-10% into all.
recipes.texture: Optional.
recipes.background_approach: BG uses only the 3 main colours, at lower contrast.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: CSS custom properties --c1..--c3, --accent; shadow tones via color-mix(in oklch, var(--c1), var(--c3) 30%).
recipes.flux_prompt: illustration in a limited palette of three muted colours and one bright accent colour on the key object
recipes.limits: Harmony evidence is weak (ADVANCED_COLOR_SCIENCE 5.1); this is craft for unity and focus.

recipes.name: Duotone spot colour
recipes.line: Lines in the darker ink.
recipes.shading: Values from tints (halftone or flat %) of 2 inks; overlaps make a third colour.
recipes.colour: Two inks (e.g. dark blue + coral) plus paper colour.
recipes.texture: Halftone dots or flat tints; paper tone.
recipes.background_approach: BG in light tints of one ink; characters in the other ink + overlap.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Two grayscale layers tinted with SVG feColorMatrix to each ink, combined with mix-blend-mode: multiply over an off-white paper div.
recipes.flux_prompt: two-colour screen print illustration, dark blue and coral ink, overprint, halftone tints, off-white paper
recipes.limits: Skin and product colours cannot be accurate.

recipes.name: Risograph overprint
recipes.line: Line work printed over solid colour blocks (reads best).
recipes.shading: Tints via machine halftone; overlaps make new colours.
recipes.colour: 2-3 spot inks (fluorescent pink, blue, yellow typical); light inks first, dark last.
recipes.texture: Grain, uneven ink, small misregistration between layers.
recipes.background_approach: Flat ink fields with lots of paper showing.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Each ink = grayscale layer -> feColorMatrix to ink colour -> mix-blend-mode: multiply; translate each layer 2-6 px randomly; feTurbulence grain masked by luminance; cap solids at 85-90%.
recipes.flux_prompt: risograph print illustration, fluorescent pink and blue spot inks, overprinted colours, grainy texture, slight misregistration, uncoated paper
recipes.limits: Fluorescent inks have no RGB/CMYK equivalent - the screen version is an approximation.

recipes.name: Golden-age comic colour (64-colour CMY tints)
recipes.line: Heavy black brush/pen line, slightly ragged.
recipes.shading: Flat; tones only from CMY tints.
recipes.colour: Only combinations of C, M, Y at 0 / ~20-25 / ~40-50 / 100% (64 colours incl. black); no gradients.
recipes.texture: Small visible dots in light tints, slight misregistration, yellowed newsprint, ink spread.
recipes.background_approach: Flat tinted BG (often one light tint) or speed lines.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Quantise fills to the 64-colour CMY palette; fill light tints with an SVG dot pattern (radius by tint); paper div #f2e8cf with multiply; offset the colour layer 1-2 px from the line layer.
recipes.flux_prompt: 1940s comic book panel, bold black ink lines, flat four-colour printing, small visible halftone dots, slight misregistration, aged newsprint
recipes.limits: Modern pop-art dot sizes are far larger than real comic dots; pick one look deliberately.

recipes.name: Black-and-white manga with screentone
recipes.line: Black ink with nib taper; speed/impact lines.
recipes.shading: Greys only from screentone patterns and solid black; gradient tone for skies/BG.
recipes.colour: B/W.
recipes.texture: Screentone patterns; white highlights scratched out of tone.
recipes.background_approach: BG in finer lines, toned; characters with fewer tones so they pop.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG dot pattern (e.g. 6 px cell) for tone; gradient tone via a mask; scratch highlights = white strokes on top.
recipes.flux_prompt: black and white manga panel, ink lines, screentone dot shading, speed lines, high contrast, white paper
recipes.limits: Tone moire when resampled - render at final size.

recipes.name: Watercolour picture-book
recipes.line: Light ink or coloured-pencil line, broken, or none.
recipes.shading: Transparent glazes; edge darkening at shape borders; soft backruns; no hard cel edges.
recipes.colour: Pastel to mid chroma; paper white is the lightest value.
recipes.texture: Cold-press paper grain, granulation in shadows, wet edges.
recipes.background_approach: Loose washes, lost edges toward the frame border; characters get the firmest edges.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: fill opacity .7-.85 + mix-blend-mode: multiply; edge darkening = same path stroked 2-4 px darker, blurred, clipped inside; grain = feTurbulence (baseFrequency ~.8) as alpha mask; blooms = blurred blobs with a darker ring.
recipes.flux_prompt: soft watercolor children's book illustration, transparent glazes, edge darkening, granulation, wet edges, cold-press paper texture, light ink line
recipes.limits: For teaching real-object facts to very young children, realistic pictures transfer better (Strouse2018) - use for mood and story.

recipes.name: Opaque gouache backgrounds
recipes.line: No lines in BG; characters may keep lines.
recipes.shading: Flat opaque value steps (3-5 per object), slightly chalky; light painted over dark.
recipes.colour: Muted, slightly desaturated, matte light colours.
recipes.texture: Dry-brush edges, visible flat brush marks.
recipes.background_approach: Flat posterised planes, atmospheric layering by value.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Posterise a FLUX BG: feComponentTransfer type='discrete' (4-5 steps) + feDisplacementMap scale 2 + grain; or prompt directly.
recipes.flux_prompt: flat gouache painting background, opaque matte colours, visible dry brush strokes, simple planes, muted palette, empty scene with no people, no text
recipes.limits: Chalky light values can look washed out next to dark-mode UI.

recipes.name: Crayon / oil-pastel picture-book
recipes.line: Waxy irregular outline with varying pressure.
recipes.shading: Scribbled fill direction, layered colours, little modelling.
recipes.colour: Bright primaries/secondaries.
recipes.texture: Paper tooth showing as white flecks; wax build-up.
recipes.background_approach: Simple scribbled BG, big empty paper areas.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Fill = colour x paper-tooth mask (feTurbulence thresholded); outline with feDisplacementMap scale 3-4, round caps; scribble hatch pattern rotated per area.
recipes.flux_prompt: children's crayon drawing illustration, waxy textured strokes, paper grain showing through, bright colours, simple shapes, white background
recipes.limits: Looks careless if the drawing is also careless - keep shapes solid, texture naive.

recipes.name: Coloured pencil, soft
recipes.line: Pencil line in a dark colour, lighter pressure on the light side.
recipes.shading: Layered directional strokes; value by pressure.
recipes.colour: Soft layered colours, optical mixing.
recipes.texture: Paper tooth, visible stroke direction.
recipes.background_approach: Light BG with vignette fade to paper.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Fine diagonal stroke pattern masked by value + feTurbulence tooth; or prompt.
recipes.flux_prompt: colored pencil illustration, soft layered strokes, visible paper texture, gentle colours, light background fading to white
recipes.limits: Fine strokes vanish under platform compression - check at final 1080 px.

recipes.name: Painted anime BG + cel character
recipes.line: Character: clean line; BG: no outlines, painted edges, sharpest edges near the focal area only.
recipes.shading: Character cel 1-2 tones; BG fully painted with light shafts and atmosphere.
recipes.colour: BG saturated skies/greenery with aerial perspective (far = lighter, bluer, lower contrast); character lit to match BG key direction and temperature.
recipes.texture: BG painterly; character flat.
recipes.background_approach: Art setting (line layout) -> art board (colour key) -> paint every angle from the board; reuse BGs across shots.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: FLUX BG + SVG puppets; light match: radial glow on the puppet side facing the BG light; darken/blur BG behind the character; contact shadow.
recipes.flux_prompt: lush painted anime background art, big cumulus clouds, summer light, soft light shafts, saturated sky and greenery, empty scene with no people, no text
recipes.limits: Pasted look if light direction/colour differ; BG detail higher than the character steals focus.

recipes.name: Flat TV-cartoon background (modernist shapes)
recipes.line: Characters outlined; BG mostly without outlines, or thin coloured lines.
recipes.shading: BG flat colour fields, maybe one shadow shape; characters flat.
recipes.colour: BG in 2-3 muted related hues; characters carry the saturated colours.
recipes.texture: None or subtle print grain.
recipes.background_approach: Stylised perspective; shapes and colour fields instead of rendered space; props as simple symbols.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Pure SVG/CSS polygons with tokens; one accent shape behind the character's head to frame it.
recipes.flux_prompt: flat modern cartoon background, simple geometric shapes and colour fields, stylized perspective, muted palette, mid-century modern design, empty scene, no text
recipes.limits: Too abstract for emotional realism; strong for comedy and explainers.

recipes.name: Line-drawn BG lighter than characters
recipes.line: BG lines thinner (0.5-0.6x) and lighter/coloured; characters have the heaviest dark line.
recipes.shading: BG flat light washes or none; characters cel.
recipes.colour: BG low chroma; characters higher chroma.
recipes.texture: Optional paper.
recipes.background_approach: Keep long structural lines (horizon, walls, floor) and drop short detail lines first.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: XDoG on a FLUX BG -> threshold -> recolour lines to the BG hue (feColorMatrix) -> opacity .6; puppets on top at full weight.
recipes.flux_prompt: simple line drawing background, thin light grey lines, minimal detail, long perspective lines, empty room, white paper
recipes.limits: Too few lines and the place becomes unreadable; long lines are the minimum (Walther2011).

recipes.name: Sparse line with suggestive contours
recipes.line: Silhouette + interior occluding contours + a few short suggestive lines where the form turns away; tapered ends; soft features not fully outlined.
recipes.shading: None, or one soft shadow shape for blobby forms.
recipes.colour: Monochrome or one accent.
recipes.texture: Optional pencil/charcoal grain.
recipes.background_approach: Sparse or empty paper.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG paths, round caps, tapered width; delete-test each line - if the shape still reads without it, delete it.
recipes.flux_prompt: minimal line drawing, few confident lines, silhouette and a few interior lines only, lots of white space
recipes.limits: Lines alone read smooth shapes poorly (Cole2009) - add a shadow shape for bodies and cushions.

recipes.name: Charcoal story frame + single accent colour
recipes.line: Charcoal lines, continuous on characters, broken on BG.
recipes.shading: Smudged soft values on characters; BG hatched in one direction, paler.
recipes.colour: Warm grey monochrome + one accent hue on the story object only.
recipes.texture: Paper grain, smudge, eraser lifts for light.
recipes.background_approach: BG separated by texture direction and lower contrast, not by outline.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Existing carousel pipeline; accent via an overlay with mix-blend-mode: color on a mask of the object.
recipes.flux_prompt: charcoal drawing on textured paper, soft smudges, expressive lines, monochrome warm grey, one small accent of colour on the key object
recipes.limits: The accent loses power when it appears on several objects.

recipes.name: Graphic noir, spotted blacks
recipes.line: Minimal lines; shapes defined by black masses.
recipes.shading: Two values (black/white) or three (plus one grey); hard shadows define form.
recipes.colour: B/W + one accent (red/amber).
recipes.texture: Optional rain/grain.
recipes.background_approach: BG mostly black; light shapes (windows, blinds) frame the character.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: threshold a render with feComponentTransfer discrete tableValues='0 1'; accent on a separate layer.
recipes.flux_prompt: graphic novel noir illustration, stark black and white, large solid black shadows, single red accent, high contrast
recipes.limits: Faces lose expression in heavy black - keep eyes/mouth in light.

recipes.name: Toon-ramp 3D (or 2D-posterised) product render
recipes.line: Contours from depth/normal edges (image space) or inverted hull; crease lines on frame edges.
recipes.shading: Light term posterised into 2-3 bands via a 1D ramp; a tiny bright band for a pseudo-highlight.
recipes.colour: Frame colour exact in the lit band; shadow band hue-shifted.
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: Flat colour or soft gradient; product dominant.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: 3D: normal/depth passes -> edge detect for lines + ramp shader. 2D: posterise a cutout's luminance with feComponentTransfer discrete '0 .55 1', then multiply with the colour layer.
recipes.flux_prompt: cel-shaded 3D render of eyeglasses, flat toon shading in two tones, clean black outlines, simple background
recipes.limits: Tiny normal changes create big shadow blotches (Motomura2015_GGXrd) - art-direct normals/shapes. Product colour can shift.

recipes.name: Depth-based abstraction for layered BGs
recipes.line: Near layers lined, far layers without lines.
recipes.shading: Near: 2-3 tone bands; mid: 2; far: 1 flat tone.
recipes.colour: Far layers lighter, cooler, lower chroma (aerial perspective).
recipes.texture: Detail and texture fade with depth.
recipes.background_approach: Parallax layers: FG dark and blurred, BG reduced, sky flat.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Per layer CSS: filter: saturate(.6) brightness(1.15) blur(var(--b)); fewer posterise steps on far layers.
recipes.flux_prompt: layered cartoon landscape, detailed foreground with outlines, distant layers as flat pale blue silhouettes, atmospheric perspective
recipes.limits: Overdone it looks foggy; the character layer must stay the crispest.

recipes.name: Webtoon soft cel + glow
recipes.line: Thin clean digital line, often coloured.
recipes.shading: Cel shadow with softened edges + airbrush gradients on hair/clothes; glow layers.
recipes.colour: Bright, slightly pastel; screen-native saturated accents.
recipes.texture: Smooth digital; additive glow for light.
recipes.background_approach: Often blurred photo-based or gradient BG.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Shadow layer multiply with 1-2 px edge blur; radial gradients with mix-blend-mode: screen for glow.
recipes.flux_prompt: webtoon style illustration, clean thin line art, soft cel shading, gentle glow, pastel colours, blurred background
recipes.limits: Screen glow and neon tones die in CMYK print (Walsworth2024_ComicPrint).

recipes.name: Chibi kawaii, thick round line
recipes.line: Thick round-capped, nearly uniform line, 1.3-1.5x normal weight.
recipes.shading: Flat or one soft shadow; blush ellipses.
recipes.colour: Pastel high-value palette; one saturated accent.
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: Simple pattern or flat pastel BG, sparkle shapes.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG stroke-linejoin/linecap round; stroke 6-8 px @1080; blush = blurred ellipses with multiply.
recipes.flux_prompt: cute chibi character, thick rounded outlines, pastel colours, simple flat shading, blush cheeks, plain pastel background
recipes.limits: Childish register; clashes with serious health advice unless intended.

recipes.name: Sticker keyline cutout
recipes.line: Thick white (or paper-colour) keyline outside the silhouette; optional thin dark line inside it.
recipes.shading: Any.
recipes.colour: Any; the keyline must contrast with the BG.
recipes.texture: Small drop shadow under the keyline for a peeled-sticker feel.
recipes.background_approach: Works on busy or photographic BGs because the keyline separates the subject.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG filter: feMorphology operator='dilate' radius 6-10 on SourceAlpha -> feFlood white -> feComposite in -> feMerge under SourceGraphic.
recipes.flux_prompt: die-cut sticker illustration, thick white border around the character, slight shadow, flat colours
recipes.limits: Reads as merch/sticker, not cinematic.

recipes.name: Print-safe cartoon colour (workflow recipe)
recipes.line: Small text and balloon text in 100% K only.
recipes.shading: No change.
recipes.colour: Design in RGB, soft-proof to the printer's CMYK profile; avoid neon/electric colours or accept dulling; rich black only for large areas, within the printer's total ink limit (235-320% depending on press/paper).
recipes.texture: Line screen and resolution per press (images 300-350 ppi).
recipes.background_approach: Avoid large saturated BG fields near the CMYK gamut edge.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: Soft-proof in Photoshop/Affinity/Krita; ImageMagick -profile for batch conversion; keep lines as a separate 100% K layer.
recipes.flux_prompt: n/a (workflow)
recipes.limits: Numbers are printer-specific - ask the printer.

recipes.name: Glasses in line art with readable lenses
recipes.line: Frame front thickest; temples thinner, tapering with distance; hinge crease lines; thin lens rims.
recipes.shading: Background lines continue through the lens with a slight shift/value change (X-junction); one designed bar highlight across the lens.
recipes.colour: Frame local colour exact; lens a faint tint (5-10% opacity).
recipes.texture: None.
recipes.background_approach: Any recipe above; the lens must show what is behind it.
recipes.build_html_css_svg: SVG: clip a copy of the BG group to the lens shape, translate 1-2 px and lower its contrast; add a diagonal white bar (opacity .6) as the highlight shape.
recipes.flux_prompt: line art illustration of eyeglasses, clear lenses showing the background through them, a single white highlight streak on each lens, clean lines
recipes.limits: FLUX often fills lenses with reflections or leaves them empty - check every output.
